blind_target.authors: Bachrach, Y., Graepel, T., Kasneci, G., Kosinski, M., & Gael, J. V.
blind_target.title: Crowd IQ: Aggregating opinions to boost performance.
blind_target.evidence_quote: Another study examined group and individual performance based on traditional (not crowdsourced) administration of the Raven’s Standard Progressive Matrices (Bachrach, Graepel, Kasneci, Kosinski & Gael, 2012), and found that response aggregation resulted in a collective IQ that exceeded the best performing individual within the group. Our crowdsourced sample also included a subset of workers who completed the entire test, thus additionally allowing a direct comparison between collective IQ of a randomly assembled crowd, and the individual IQ of its constituent members.
blind_target.outcome_quote: The collective IQ was not statistically distinguishable from the IQ of the best performing individual within that group for any of the group sizes.

luna_triage.reason: The paper explicitly re-tests the claim that aggregation lets a crowd exceed its best individual and cites Bachrach et al. (2012), while the supplied row is another 2012 Crowd IQ work by overlapping authors. The supplied materials do not establish whether these are separate papers/findings or alternate reports of the same original. Need source reference-list metadata or publication-level equivalence evidence to distinguish representation from omission.
luna_triage.omission_quote: Another study examined group and individual performance based on traditional (not crowdsourced) administration of the Raven’s Standard Progressive Matrices (Bachrach, Graepel, Kasneci, Kosinski & Gael, 2012), and found that response aggregation resulted in a collective IQ that exceeded the best performing individual within the group.
luna_triage.identity_quote: Crowd IQ: Aggregating opinions to boost performance.

quality_gate: Luna is triage only. Independently establish actual empirical retesting and absence under ALL shipped identities/alternate reports. Read prior objections. No paper outcome is being requested.
